title: Arrowmax unveils AI-powered electric screwdriver
excerpt: Arrowmax is introducing a new smart electric screwdriver equipped with an integrated camera and artificial intelligence.
body_html:
Tool manufacturer Arrowmax is developing a new electric screwdriver designed to simplify the process of selecting the correct drill bit. The upcoming device incorporates an integrated camera and artificial intelligence technology to automatically determine the appropriate bit type and size needed for a specific task.

By utilizing this system, users can avoid the trial-and-error process typically required when sorting through various screwdriver bits. While companies such as Hoto and Fanttik have previously focused on improving the physical design and functionality of electric screwdrivers, Arrowmax is aiming to introduce greater convenience and intelligence into standard tool usage.
